about_the_game:
Retro arcade shooter inspired by classic 80's games

Blast through relentless waves of enemies in this fast-paced side-scrolling shoot ’em up. Pilot your ship across looping battlefields, dodge swarms of bullets, and unleash devastating firepower while protecting vital ground targets. Tight controls, explosive combat, and arcade-inspired polish bring classic shooter action into the modern era.

Full Game Features

  • Arcade-style combat – smooth physics-driven movement and responsive controls.

  • Bullet hell intensity – dodge intricate enemy patterns and survive overwhelming odds.

  • Protect & survive – defend ground targets from bombing waves and kamikaze strikes.

  • Dynamic levels – turn zones, looping stages, and cinematic hyperspace jumps.

  • Shield mechanics – deploy or drop shields for tactical defence.

  • Enemy variety – scouts, bombers, interceptors, wreckers, and more with unique behaviours.

  • Immersive audio & VFX – layered engine sounds, shield effects, and arcade explosions.

  • Scoring & challenge – chase high scores, master enemy waves, and prove your skill.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300 (dual/quad-core ~3.0 GHz)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 530, NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750, or AMD R7 250 (any GPU with ~2 GB VRAM, DirectX 11 support)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Gamepad support recommended (Xbox / DualShock / equivalent).
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or better
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / GTX 1650, or AMD RX 570 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Gamepad support recommended (Xbox / DualShock / equivalent).
